title: L1-planning-backlog-prioritizer Output
description: Items carry per-feature scoring meta-points only (structural fields stay full: ids, scores, ranks, dependency links). The full ranked narrative, per-feature rationale, and sequencing writeup live ONLY in the artifacts[0] document (prioritized-backlog.md). Any *_summary/summary string here is a distillation (<=150 chars), never a copy of the artifact text.

prioritized_features.description: One entry per input feature, ranked descending by priority score.

gaps.description: Features that could not be fully scored (missing value inputs, unresolved dependency reference, etc).

source_reference.description: Which input artifact this value came from, e.g. 'features.json' or 'value-scoring-sheet.xlsx'.

source_location.description: Locator within that source, e.g. feature id or row/cell reference.

feature_id.description: Feature id, format F-{epic}.{seq}, matching feature-decomposer output.

rank.description: 1 = highest priority. Sequential, no duplicates or gaps.

priority_score.description: Final composite score used for ranking (WSJF quotient or RICE score).

value_score.description: Normalized business value input (0-100), as supplied or derived from Product Lead inputs.

effort_estimate.description: Effort/job size, in the same unit supplied in value_scoring_inputs (points or size tier).

dependency_unblocking_score.description: How much delivering this feature unblocks downstream features, derived from the dependency graph fan-out.

blocks_feature_ids.description: Feature ids that cannot start until this one is delivered.

blocked_by_feature_ids.description: Feature ids this feature is waiting on.

summary.description: Distilled one-line rationale. Full rationale is in the artifact only.

duplicate_flag.description: True if tool-L1-jira-fetch-issue found a likely-duplicate issue in the adjacent backlog (only set when adjacent_backlog_check=true).
